answer: Yes. Idioms such as “ohne Rückgrat” (without backbone) and “von Grund des Herzens” (from the bottom of one’s heart) sharpen Gregor’s judgments and lend authenticity to his inner voice. His employer’s anticipated “Donnerwetter” metaphorically turns a reprimand into a thunderstorm, while Gregor’s transformation into vermin gives concrete form to his dehumanization under oppressive work and family obligations.
